resources.string: Tap \"Add link\" and select every link, so signal.me and group invite links open here instead of the browser
Open it with your fingerprint or screen lock. Its messages are hidden in the chat list and notifications.
Set up a fingerprint or screen lock on your phone first
Use a phone contact\'s name and photo, even if they hide their number. Stays linked.
Pick your own photo for this person. Only you see it.

Version 10
• Replying to one photo works like a normal reply: add photos, videos, GIFs, files, Immich photos or a sticker

Version 9
• Translate a message: long-press it and tap Translate. It uses your phone's offline translator; nothing leaves the phone
• Transcribe voice messages: long-press one and tap Transcribe. It runs entirely on your phone; audio never leaves it (Android 13 and up)
• Note to Self works as a reminder: a new note keeps it unread (on every device) until you open it again
• Remind me: long-press a message and pick when to be reminded about it
• Keyword alerts: muted chats still notify you when someone uses words you pick (Settings > Notifications)
• Optional: accept changed safety numbers without confirming each one (Settings > Privacy, off by default)
• Moving over from Signal is backup and restore only; the Link device button is gone
• A phone contact you linked by hand, and your own photo for someone, now show on your linked computers too (Backchannel Web and Signal Desktop)
• Comment on one photo of a multi-photo message: open it, then tap Reply at the top. The reply quotes the message and carries that photo.
• Immich: attach photos and videos straight from your own Immich server (attach menu > Immich)

Version 8
• The message box under a photo or video stays above the keyboard
• Lists, indents, headings, quotes and code blocks: type markdown like * item, # Title, > quote or ``` and everyone sees it, Signal users too
• This What's New screen, after every update

Version 6
• Link anyone to a phone contact, even if they hide their number (chat settings > Link to phone contact). It stays linked.
• Your own photo for anyone, even people not in your contacts (chat settings > Contact photo)
• Lock any chat behind your fingerprint (chat settings > Lock this chat)
• Double-tap a message to react
• Starred messages
• Typed :) ;) :( turn into emoji
• Attach photos through Google Photos or another photo app that lets you pick (from Immich, use Share > Backchannel)
• One default emoji skin tone (Settings > Chats)
• Open Signal links in Backchannel (Settings > Chats)
• Google push is the default, through Backchannel's own registration
• Emoji reaction tabs no longer sit under the navigation bar
• Setup screens say Backchannel instead of Signal

Version 4
• New icon
• Passphrase is optional, and screenshots are allowed
• Screens fit around the navigation bar and keyboard

First release
• Reply privately to a group message
• Forward to any number of chats, with @mentions
• Send one poll to many chats
• Markdown shortcuts, bold italic, and styled copies
• Sticker replies
Add photos, videos, GIFs or files
Search didn\'t work. It needs Smart Search turned on in Immich.
Attach photos and videos straight from your own Immich server. The address and key stay on this phone.
In Immich on the web, open Account settings > API keys > New API key. Give it All permissions, or at least asset read, view and download, album read and user read.

Moving over from Signal? In Signal, make an on-device backup (Settings > Backups) and write down its 30-digit code. Here, tap Restore or transfer and pick that backup. Then disable or uninstall Signal on this phone.
When someone\'s safety number changes, like on a new phone, keep sending without asking you to confirm. The chat still shows that it changed.

Muted chats still notify you when a new message contains one of these words. Separate words with commas.
